issues.description: Return type annotation for simulate_msd_one_round is inconsistent between the problem statement/specification and the template. The problem statement (and the solution) specify that simulate_msd_one_round should return a tuple (error_rate, acceptance_rate) of two floats (tuple[float, float]). In the template file, simulate_msd_one_round is annotated to return list[float] which conflicts with the spec and the solution implementation. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and may cause type-checking or test harness issues.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the template function signature/annotation for simulate_msd_one_round to match the specification and solution: change the return annotation from list[float] to tuple[float, float], and ensure the docstring and any callers expect and handle a (error_rate, acceptance_rate) tuple.
